description: An extended tag query unions complete suffix witnesses and excludes shorter or misaligned readings (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text ($x:candidate Y) %conditions $x.without-elision.onward.tags(rival) = (A ∪ B)

%rule candidate (X [+T])
%rule rival (X [+T] Y [+U]) :: A | (X [+T] Y [+V]) :: B | (X [+T]) :: Short | (X [+T] [+W] Y) :: Extra
